identifying_description:
(a) high necked pigeon-breast bodice of black silk net embroidered with black sequins and rhinestones over white silk satin: gathered into a shirred grosgrain cummerbund at waist; puffed 3/4 sleeve of silk net gathered at elbow; finished with ruffle cuff; square yoke at neck of white silk satin trimmed with black sequins embroidery; standing collar of the same; yoke and center front bodice trimmed with pink silk satin ribbon, pale velvet trim, and pink tassels; (b) full trained skirt of black silk net and silk lace embroidered with black sequins: black velvet bottom hem; knife-pleated cream chiffon around bottom; train and lower park of skirt lined with cream silk satin.

Label: "Blancquaert, Court Dressmaker & Ladies Tailor, London
